mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE shared_channels AS ( SELECT ch.*, s.exposed_code AS exposed_code FROM gb_device_channel ch INNER JOIN gb_platform_share s ON s.resource_id = ch.id WHERE s.platform_id = #{platformId} AND ch.parental = 0 ), group_ancestors AS ( -- 共享通道的直接父分组 SELECT g.* FROM gb_device_channel g INNER JOIN shared_channels sc ON g.channel_id = sc.parent_id AND g.parental = 1 UNION -- 父分组的祖先分组（递归） SELECT g.* FROM gb_device_channel g INNER JOIN group_ancestors ga ON g.channel_id = ga.parent_id AND g.parental = 1 ) SELECT id, device_id, channel_id, parent_id, parental, name, manufacturer, model, owner, civil_code, address, safety_way, register_way, secrecy, status, ip_address, port, password, ptz_type, longitude, latitude, create_time, update_time, NULL AS exposed_code FROM group_ancestors UNION ALL SELECT id, device_id, channel_id, parent_id, parental, name, manufacturer, model, owner, civil_code, address, safety_way, register_way, secrecy, status, ip_address, port, password, ptz_type, longitude, latitude, create_time, update_time, exposed_code FROM shared_channels ORDER BY parental DESC, channel_id ASC
SELECT ch.*, s.exposed_code AS exposed_code FROM gb_device_channel ch INNER JOIN gb_platform_share s ON s.resource_id = ch.id WHERE s.platform_id = #{platformId} ORDER BY ch.channel_id ASC
